1  ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:21291  CRL.RP No. 930 of 2019  ORDER 1.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo of even date seeking permission of this court to convert the Criminal Revision Petition to Criminal Petition.

3. In earlier round of litigation, PCR was filed by the complainant against the respondents before the Magistrate for the offences under Sections 420, 468, 471 read with Section 120-B of Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC').
The jurisdictional police submitted 'B' report and it was accepted by the Trial Court.

Being aggrieved by the same, the criminal revision petition was filed by the petitioner /
complainant before the Revisional Court, which was dismissed against which the second revision does not lie.
However, inadvertently, this revision petition is filed against the order of the revision which is not maintainable.

4. Nevertheless, today, learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo seeking permission to convert this criminal revision petition to criminal petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
NC: 2023:KHC:21291 5.
Hence, it is appropriate to direct the petitioner to convert the Criminal Revision Petition into Criminal Appeal.

6. For statistical purpose, this criminal revision petition stands disposed of.
Sd/-
